authority.rule: Repository evidence may freeze intended Play Console answers, but external console acceptance, processor-contract status, and Zero Data Retention authority remain external.

dataCollectionAndSecurity.sharingBasis: Transfers to Supabase and OpenAI are treated as service-provider processing on behalf of BEJEWELY; final processor-contract confirmation remains external authority.
dataCollectionAndSecurity.encryptedInTransitBasis: Production mobile API and Supabase endpoints are required to use HTTPS; non-production development may use HTTP only outside production.
dataCollectionAndSecurity.deletionRequestBasis: MOBILE-16A provides authenticated in-app hard account deletion and a public external account-deletion request route.

dataTypes.basis: Name can be supplied by an optional authenticated account provider/profile path; core analysis can be used without signing in.
Email is collected only through optional authenticated account flows and is not required for the anonymous core-analysis path.
Authenticated requests may be linked to a Supabase account user ID; sign-in is optional for the core-analysis path.
Skin profile, sensitivity, concerns, condition and related survey state are treated conservatively as health-related information for disclosure; this is not a diagnostic or medical-product claim.

A face photo is transmitted to the BEJEWELY server and then to OpenAI vision for the core photo-analysis flow. BEJEWELY does not persist the raw photo in analysis_requests or analysis_results, but the OpenAI project Zero Data Retention state is not yet verified, so the photo must not be declared ephemeral/non-collected.
Free-form skin-diary memo content is user-provided, stored for the diary feature, and optional.
